failed_or_abandoned: Exponential angular form exp(-a(1-cos theta)) with a=(kR)^2/2 (Gaussian diffraction lobe): gives f(E_R>200 keV) ~ 3e-6 at all energies, three orders of magnitude below the black-disk pattern because it lacks secondary maxima; computed and reported, not used.
First script run failed on a missing keyword argument in frac_between (fixed).
MC error propagation with max(count,1) for zero-count bulk components inflated the quoted uncertainty; the bulk is kinematically zero above 200 keV (E_n < 6.6 MeV), so the term was removed.

A first-principles derivation of the 13C share of PTFE (alpha,n) neutrons was not possible from the paper; replaced by recalled thick-target yields with a x3 uncertainty and a f_C scan (5e-4, 2.5e-3, 1e-2).
